_doc: Inline French/English text branches (`x === "fr" ? … : …`, `fr ? … : …`) still allowed, per file, with why. scripts/i18n/check-languages.mjs (inlineBranches) counts them; the test fails when a file goes over its count or a new file has one. A new text goes in a dictionary instead (docs/LANGUES.md). Lower a count when you remove one.
